definitions.meaning: A province of Germany, now the duchy of Carinthia or Kärnthen, a crown land of the Austrian empire

quotations.old_english: On óðre healfe Donua ðære eá is ðæt land Carendre, súþ óþ ða beorgas ðe man hǽt Alpis
quotations.english: on the other side of the river Danube is the country Carinthia, [lying] south to the mountains which are called the Alps

quotations.old_english: Be eástan Carendran is Pulgara land
quotations.english: to the east of Carinthia is the country of the Bulgarians

source_text: Carendre, an; f, A province of Germany, now the duchy of Carinthia or Kärnthen, a crown land of the Austrian empire :-- On óðre healfe Donua ðære eá is ðæt land Carendre, súþ óþ ða beorgas ðe man hǽt Alpis on the other side of the river Danube is the country Carinthia, [lying] south to the mountains which are called the Alps, Ors. 1, 1; Bos. 18, 43. Be eástan Carendran is Pulgara land to the east of Carinthia is the country of the Bulgarians, 1, 1; Bos. 19, 1.
